text: Determinism [Lat. de + terminus , end]: Ger. Determinismus ; Fr. déterminisme ; Ital. determinismo . The theory according to which choice between alternative courses of conduct can, in all cases, be fully accounted for by psychological and other conditions. See FREE WILL CONTROVERSIES, and DETERMINATION (mental). ( G.F.S. - J.M.B. )
